visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young boys, a toddler around 2 and a boy around 5, are seated at a white dining table in a modern apartment. The toddler sits in a grey high chair wearing a blue shirt and diaper, while the older boy sits in a beige chair wearing a white graphic t-shirt. The table is set with various food items, including rice and meat. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The older boy carefully feeds the toddler with a spoon. The toddler accepts the food but shortly after starts chewing with difficulty, eventually spitting the food out onto his hands and the table. The older boy watches intently with a patient expression. (3) The older boy picks up a piece of food and attempts to feed himself, while the toddler grabs a spoon and tries to scoop food from the older boy's plate. A woman's hand enters the frame from the right to help wipe the toddler's face and clean the table. Both children appear happy and engaged in the interaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with light, acoustic guitar-driven BGM in a major key. The older boy's voice is high-pitched and encouraging. Clinking sounds of cutlery on plates are audible. (2) A sharp, wet sound of the toddler spitting followed by the toddler's babbling triggers a shift. The older boy's tone becomes slightly more assertive as he reacts. (3) An adult female voice (the mother) enters with high arousal and a joyful tone, laughing loudly. The laughter creates a broad spectral peak. Sounds of tissue rustling and metal spoons scraping the table are prominent. The music remains a consistent, upbeat backdrop throughout the interaction.
